metadata.name: rakurai_client_config
metadata.description: On-chain validator config: block-engine endpoints, post-pack (P2C) URLs, and virtual-priority maps

instructions.name: abort_global_staging
docs: Manager-only: close global staging without applying.

instructions.name: abort_proposal_staging
docs: Operator-only: close proposal staging without applying.

instructions.name: abort_validator_staging
docs: Manager-only: close validator staging without applying.

instructions.name: approve_proposal
docs: Manager-only: copy proposal → live validator config, then close proposal (rent → operator).

instructions.name: close_global
docs: Manager-only: close global config PDA and reclaim rent.

instructions.name: close_validator
docs: Manager-only: close per-vote validator config PDA and reclaim rent.

instructions.name: commit_global_staging
docs: Manager-only: deserialize staging payload into live global config, then close staging.

instructions.name: commit_proposal_staging
docs: Operator-only: apply staging payload onto the proposal PDA, then close staging.
Proposal must already exist (small `init_proposal` with empty config is enough).

instructions.name: commit_validator_staging
docs: Manager-only: apply staging payload to live validator overlay, then close staging.

instructions.name: init_global
docs: Create the singleton global config. Signer becomes `manager`.
`limits` must be non-zero and ≤ absolute safety caps.

instructions.name: init_global_staging
docs: Manager-only: create ephemeral global staging PDA for a chunked config upload.

instructions.name: init_proposal
docs: Operator-only: create proposal PDA with suggested config.
Copies validator `limits` onto the proposal; validates against those caps.

instructions.name: init_proposal_staging
docs: Operator-only: create ephemeral proposal staging PDA.

instructions.name: init_validator
docs: Manager-only: create per-vote validator PDA, copying current global config + limits.
`operator` may later propose changes via the proposal PDA.

instructions.name: init_validator_staging
docs: Manager-only: create ephemeral validator staging PDA.

instructions.name: reject_proposal
docs: Manager-only: close proposal without changing live validator config (rent → operator).

instructions.name: set_operator
docs: Manager-only: set who may propose for this vote.

instructions.name: update_global
docs: Manager-only: replace global config payload.
Reallocs the account to the serialized size of the new config (dynamic Vec/String).

instructions.name: update_global_limits
docs: Manager-only: update global size caps (≤ absolute safety caps; must fit current payload).

instructions.name: update_proposal
docs: Operator-only: replace proposal payload (reallocs).
Refreshes proposal `limits` from the validator PDA; validates against those caps.

instructions.name: update_validator
docs: Manager-only: replace validator-specific config (independent of global after copy).
Reallocs the account to the serialized size of the new config (dynamic Vec/String).

instructions.name: update_validator_limits
docs: Manager-only: update this vote's size caps (≤ absolute safety caps; must fit current payload).

instructions.name: write_global_staging
docs: Manager-only: append a chunk to global staging.

instructions.name: write_proposal_staging
docs: Operator-only: append a chunk to proposal staging.

instructions.name: write_validator_staging
docs: Manager-only: append a chunk to validator staging.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the config manager may perform this action

errors.name: UnauthorizedOperator
errors.msg: Only the validator operator may propose

errors.name: VoteMismatch
errors.msg: Vote account does not match validator config

errors.name: OperatorMismatch
errors.msg: Operator account does not match proposal

errors.name: TooManySets
errors.msg: Too many named sets for this section

errors.name: TooManyUrls
errors.msg: Too many URLs in a set

errors.name: TooManyVpEntries
errors.msg: Too many virtual-priority entries in a set

errors.name: InvalidLimits
errors.msg: ConfigLimits are zero or exceed absolute safety caps

errors.name: StagingKindInvalid
errors.msg: Staging kind does not match this instruction

errors.name: StagingTooLarge
errors.msg: Staging payload is empty or exceeds MAX_STAGING_BYTES

errors.name: StagingDeserializeFailed
errors.msg: Failed to deserialize Config from staging bytes

fields.name: max_bundles
docs: Bundles admitted per `period_ms`. 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: period_ms
docs: Quota window in milliseconds. 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: max_bundle_burst
docs: Token-bucket capacity. If 0 and quota is set, treat as equal to `max_bundles`.

fields.name: sets
docs: Dynamic list of named endpoint groups; realloc when this grows/shrinks.

types.name: Config
docs: Versioned config payload shared by global and validator PDAs.

types.name: ConfigLimits
docs: Versioned size caps stored on Global / Validator / Proposal.

types.name: ConfigLimitsV1
docs: Size-cap fields for one limits schema version.

types.name: ConfigStaging
docs: Ephemeral upload buffer. Create → append chunks → commit into live PDA → close.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = global, 1 = validator, 2 = proposal.

fields.name: vote
docs: Vote pubkey for validator/proposal staging; default for global.

types.name: ConfigV1
docs: Shared V1 payload for global and validator PDAs (no mode).
`String` / `Vec` fields are dynamically sized: account bytes grow/shrink via
`realloc_to_fit` on every init/update. Caps come from account `ConfigLimits`.

fields.name: sets
docs: Dynamic list of named endpoint groups; realloc when this grows/shrinks.

fields.name: operator
docs: Key allowed to create/update the proposal PDA for this vote.

types.name: ValidatorProposal
docs: Per-vote draft config. Live clients ignore this until manager approve.

fields.name: operator
docs: Operator who proposed; receives rent on approve/reject close.

fields.name: value
docs: Fraction of tip used for virtual priority; must be in `[0.0, 1.0]`.

fields.name: sets
docs: Dynamic list of named priority groups; realloc when this grows/shrinks.
